newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen B shares end up sharply, turnover down.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen B shares end up sharply, turnover down.

text.p: Shenzhen's B share index maintained its upward trend on Friday and closed sharply higher on cautious buying ahead of the weekend, brokers said.
The B index rose 5.18 points, or 4.60 percent, to 117.82, but turnover fell to HK$193.74 million from Thursday's HK$247.60 million.

Brokers said some investors stayed on the sidelines after recent surges and ahead of the weekend, with profit-taking of issues which rose sharply this week. "The market's upward momentum should extend into next week unless securities regulators release negative news," one broker said.
Jiangling Motors, the strongest performer, soared HK$0.41, or 15.71 percent, to HK$3.02 on volume of 1.15 million shares.
Conglomerate Zhonghao followed with a rise of HK$0.37, or 12.54 percent, to HK$3.32 on trade of 810,481 shares.
Changan Automobile remained the focus of institutional trading, climbing HK$0.19 to HK$2.69, on the day's heaviest volume of 11.20 million shares.
Dadonghai, the second most active counter, rose HK$0.15 to HK$2.58, with 5.46 million shares changing hands.
Refrigerator maker Meilin firmed HK$0.40 to HK$4.00 on volume of 4.28 million shares.
A company spokesman said on Friday the firm is confident of beating its 1996 net earnings target of 138 million yuan due to stronger demand for its refrigerators.
Watch maker Fiyta fell HK$0.09 to HK$4.00 on trade of 958,780 shares due to profit-taking, brokers said.

The A market reversed early losses with a strong technical rebound late in the session after Thursday's plunge, which was triggered by rumours that Beijing plans fresh measures to counter excessive speculation in stock trading, brokers said.

The A index surged 13.80 points, or 3.20 percent, to 445.10 on turnover of 12.78 billion yuan, compared with 18.31 billion the previous session. The composite index closed up 13.11 points, or 3.25 percent, at 416.06.
Automobile parts maker Changchun Lanbao Co Ltd, which listed 16 million A shares and five million staff shares in Shenzhen on Friday, ended the session at 17.55 yuan.
